notes.title: Hard at work!
notes.content: [p][b]Hard at work![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are making huge progress to downtown. We have finished the hospital, police station and we are moving on to the park soon! Here are some screenshots of it all coming together.  We can't wait to get this in your hands later in 2026. notes.title: We've have hit a new milestone!
notes.content: [p]We have been hard at work to get Blu-Dude ready to explore with you. We have fixed the save system so it will be ready at launch!  We have also added more scenes for you to explore starting with certain objects might change outcomes later in the game.  [/p]
